decisions: Promote a maintained retained-receipt gate, not a second live environment experiment.
Preserve archived round14 capture source and observations byte-for-byte; no historical main/evaluate/write_receipt calls.
Public CLI checks receipts as data only: never execute retained argv or open retained root paths.
Separate byte-integrity refusal from well-formed semantic mismatch; selftest asserts literal exit and stable finding pairs through subprocess CLI.
A frozen retained replay is not a rerun of the original git/probe experiment, authentication, broad environment independence or result reuse.

Build-seat recommendations about root overrides, live git shims, extra capture modes and all possible fixture branches are advisory design alternatives, not newly admitted requirements. The check-only cutover avoids their live-write risks.
Same-lane swarm reviews are advisory; independent non-author admission and admit/reject sampling remain closure duties.

The orchestrator first moved scout/connector routing after Cursor quota failures, then superseded that decision: newly spawned scout/labrat uses m_fast, connector m_haiku, executor m_swe, critic m_sol. m_flash was also out of credits402. This lane did not mutate routing or replace failed identities.
